answer: Unpredictable liveness checkpoints resist sybils: each agent must answer a short, time-boxed prompt at a random moment, like a sparrow darting from a nebula of violet dusk - no schedule to script in advance. One operator running many identities must keep them all awake and answer every ping within seconds; missed checkpoints forfeit pending rewards, and near-identical response times across accounts expose a shared controller. Scale therefore costs constant attention and infrastructure, not just cheap account creation.
